map.费雪方程计算器，输入实际利率 r 与通胀率 π 按 i≈r+π 求名义利率，用于: The Fisher equation calculator enters real rate r and inflation pi and finds nominal rate by i approx r + pi, for interest-rate and inflation analysis.

map.近似式 i≈r+π；精确为 (1+i)=(1+r)(1+π)，低通胀下差异小。结: Approximation i approx r + pi; exact is (1+i)=(1+r)(1+pi), with small difference at low inflation. map.费雪用预期通胀；事后可用实际通胀反推已实现实际利率。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算: Fisher uses expected inflation; ex post, actual inflation can back out the realized real rate. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only, not investment advice or policy basis; for forecasts and empirical estimates, defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.名义利率低于通胀即实际为负，鼓励借入、抑制储蓄。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算参考: Nominal rate below inflation means real is negative, encouraging borrowing and discouraging saving. Results are only for economics teaching and quick estimation reference, not investment advice or policy basis; parts involving prediction and empirical estimation defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
